name: Blieskastel (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Blieskastel (Saint Sebastian on white).
history: Municipal flag of Blieskastel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Blieskastel arms — Saint Sebastian on white
